name: tech-prediction-methods-validation-20261020-sameday
notes: ADR-0273 ten-method study, VALIDATION document on the SECONDARY same-day label (reported, not in the family): 2021-2025 annual folds scored once with the knobs frozen from the development document (prediction-methods-selection.json). Family per cell: ten method-vs-lagged DM comparisons and ten method-vs-mean gaps, BH 5%. No trade rule, P&L or edge claim.

panel_surface.notes: Pair differences, legs, prior-only Z/sd and changes of the surface panel: 30-DTE surface at the t close (our Black-76 IVs from Theta NBBO).

panel_returns.notes: Pair differences, legs, prior-only Z/sd and changes of the returns panel: adjusted-close log returns through the t close; the 20-session leg sd is realized vol.
